name: Gokapi
description: Share files with links that expire after a set number of downloads or days

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your uploaded files and the SQLite database with links, users and download counts. Back it up.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: The settings from the setup page (config.json), with password salts and any encryption key. Back it up together with data. Do not delete it.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Gokapi upload page, admin menu and download links, published on host as 6874

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.
